overview.brief: Abandoned waterworks and catacombs beneath Qeynos (tools/wiki page title: Qeynos Aqueducts). Early tunnels of rats/bats/beetles; deeper smugglers, undead, frogloks, cultists, gelatinous cubes. EQ Legends Tools recommends 3–13.
